lines.text: The law has authority over a man only as long as he lives, as a married woman's bond shows.
Believers died to the law through Christ's body, so they might belong to Moses and bear fruit to God.

wrong_details.true: Him who was raised from the dead

lines.text: Believers have been released from the law, so they serve in the new way of the Spirit.
The law is not sin, yet the writer would not have been aware of stealing without the law.
Sin deceived the writer through the commandment, and the commandment is holy, righteous, and good.
